result.instructions: Tools for DreamClass, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which students in 2026/27 have an unpaid invoice?"; "Show the attendance of class 4B for this month."; "Who are the guardians of the student Sarah Lee?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DreamClass data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dreamclass_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dreamclass_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dreamclass_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dreamclass_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_school_periods
tools.title: List school periods
tools.description: List the school periods (school years and terms) with their ids, names and dates. Call this first: most other tools need a schoolPeriodId from this list. GET /curriculum/schoolperiods/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the courses the school offers, with their ids. GET /curriculum/courses/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_period_classes
tools.title: List classes in a period
tools.description: List the classes (student groups) of one school period. GET /curriculum/schoolperiod/{schoolPeriodId}/classes.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_period_class_courses
tools.title: List class courses in a period
tools.description: List the class courses of one school period: each course taught to a class, with its id. Assignments and gradebooks use these class-course ids. GET /curriculum/schoolperiod/{schoolPeriodId}/classcourses.

annotations.title: List class courses in a period

tools.name: dreamclass_list_period_students
tools.title: List students in a period
tools.description: List the students enrolled in one school period, with their enrollment ids and levels. Pass studentId to get one student's enrollment. GET /students/schoolperiod/{schoolPeriodId}/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_search_students
tools.title: Search students
tools.description: Find students whose last name or email matches the text. Returns contact details and birthdate for each match. GET /students/records/list/{nameOrEmail}.

nameOrEmail.description: Text to match against the last name or the email.

tools.name: dreamclass_get_student
tools.title: Get a student
tools.description: Get one student's record: contact details, birthdate, address and custom fields. GET /students/records/get/{studentId}.

tools.name: dreamclass_get_student_guardians
tools.title: List a student's guardians
tools.description: List the guardians (parents or carers) linked to a student, with their contact details. GET /students/records/get/{studentId}/guardians.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_attendance_statuses
tools.title: List attendance statuses
tools.description: List the attendance status values the school uses (for example present or absent), with their ids. GET /students/attendance/status/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_daily_attendance
tools.title: List daily attendance
tools.description: List daily attendance records, for classes that use daily attendance. Filter by period, student or date range. GET /students/attendance/daily/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_assignments
tools.title: List assignments
tools.description: List assignments of one class course. Without classCourseId, list all class-course assignments of a school period. classCourseId wins when both are set. GET /assignments/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_get_gradebook
tools.title: Get a gradebook
tools.description: Get the gradebook of one class course: its grade columns, weights and types. Use the grade ids with the grade-value tools. GET /grading/gradebook.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_professors
tools.title: List teachers
tools.description: List the teachers (professors) of the school, or only those in one school period. GET /professors/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_announcements
tools.title: List announcements
tools.description: List the announcements of the school, or of one school period. GET /announcements/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_list_period_fees
tools.title: List fees in a period
tools.description: List the fee definitions of one school period: description, amount, period, interval and start date. GET /financial/fees/schoolperiod/{schoolPeriodId}/list.

tools.name: dreamclass_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice: status (1 unpaid, 2 partly paid, 3 fully paid), amounts, dates, payer and fee lines. GET /financial/invoices/get/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: dreamclass_add_note
tools.title: Add a student note
tools.description: Add a note to a student record. Each visibility flag defaults to false: set every flag you need, because the note is shown only where its flag is true. POST /notes.

user_id.description: Student id the note is about.

reporter_id.description: Id of the staff member who writes the note.

school_period_id.description: School period id the note belongs to.

school_tag_ids.description: Tag ids (from the settings tag list).

visible_to_student.description: Show the note to the student.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with DreamClass
prompts.description: What you can do with DreamClass here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_school_periods_classes_and_class_courses
prompts.title: Find the school periods, classes and class courses
prompts.description: List the school periods first. Then list the classes and the class courses of one period, and use their ids in other tools.

prompts.name: find_a_student_and_the_guardians_to_contact
prompts.title: Find a student and the guardians to contact
prompts.description: Search students by last name or email. Open one record, then list its guardians with their contact details.

prompts.name: check_daily_attendance_for_a_school_period
prompts.title: Check daily attendance for a school period
prompts.description: List the students of one period and the attendance statuses. Then list the daily attendance by period, student or date range.

prompts.name: review_assignments_and_the_gradebook_of_a_course
prompts.title: Review assignments and the gradebook of a course
prompts.description: List the assignments of one class course. Then open its gradebook to see the grade columns, weights and types.

prompts.name: check_one_invoice_and_the_fees_of_a_period
prompts.title: Check one invoice and the fees of a period
prompts.description: List the fee definitions of a school period. Open an invoice by its id to read its status, amounts, dates, payer and fee lines.

prompts.name: add_a_note_to_a_student_record
prompts.title: Add a note to a student record
prompts.description: Find the student, then add a note with the visibility flags you need. Each flag defaults to false, so a note shows only where its flag is true.
